Answer: B
Reason: Figure 1 shows bilateral alveolar infiltrates, and Figure 3 demonstrates progression to dense consolidation predominantly in the left lung; this pattern of worsening unilateral/bilateral opacities is consistent with diffuse alveolar damage and microbleeds seen in exercise-induced pulmonary hemorrhage (EIPH), rather than the rapid resolution expected in pneumonia or the symmetric distribution typical of cardiogenic edema.
